Allied Properties Real Estate Investment Trust (
) announced on Wednesday that Cecilia Williams will step down as president and chief executive officer.

The company added that it launched a search for a successor and Williams will continue to serve in her current role during the search, leading the business, advancing Allied’s strategic priorities, and providing continuity for employees, tenants, and other stakeholders.

title: Allied  Properties CEO to step down
